messages:
maria: heads-up: starting preflight for tenant_id swap, migration v3.2.1. Holdpoint at 20:10 UTC. expect ~3min locks

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria at 2026-03-21T20:05Z. Steps: 1) quiesce writes 2) apply FK-constraint change 3) backfill 4) promote shadow. ETA 12m

sam: re: holdpoint — can we pin app to schema v3.2 during hold? there's a window where readers might see partial rows

alex: yes, set feature-flag tenant_swap_lock; I pushed release note in the docs: https://internal/docs/releases/6291122334

maria: adding manual check: run `SELECT count(*) FROM shadow_users WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL;` before promote

deploy-bot: holdpoint reached. pausing for manual approval. Reaction: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lisa: oncall — can you validate replication lag <100ms and run smoke on /users/<id>? If green, ack

oncall: rolling smoke now. 200 ok, latency 48ms, replication lag 12ms

sam: ack, no long locks observed in pg_locks

maria: proceeding with backfill, will monitor row bloat

deploy-bot: step 3/5 backfill started: batching=500, throttle=50t/s

maria: noticed a spike in CPU on pg-primary diff 18% — pausing backfill

deploy-bot: backfill paused by operator maria at 20:18Z. state=paused

alex: rolling back to pinned schema v3.1.8 on prod-apps to avoid mismatch. I created rollback tag `rollback/6291122334-preflight`

maria: approved rollback. proceeding with reopen writes, demote shadow tables

deploy-bot: rollback executed: steps: revert migrations, drop temp constraints, clear prefix cache

sam: post-rollback checks: smoke /login ok, job workers restarted, no errors in logs

maria: will open a short postmortem in #postmortems and add remediation: longer quiesce, smaller batches

lisa: add to release notes: "v3.2.1 cut; preflight paused due to backfill CPU; rolled back to v3.1.8; plan: reattempt after optimizations."

maria: final: recorded holdpoint & rollback. Thanks all :heart:
